content.orig:
The problem is, War2 was originally made for PCs, so all the ASCII characters are formatted
to the PCs' type.
It is almost impossible to get them without directly transporting the "war2.ini" from a PC
to the "Warcraft II Preferences" on a Mac. I personally made an AppleScript because I was
so pissed at this that would insert the characters and colors.
